text: Fixing #6509 (runtime part): parse_string/parse_bracket_literal/parse_braced_literal returned accumulated text at end of input, so RETURN 'unterminated etc. ran as a complete literal. They now throw a localized Unterminated{String,Bracket,Brace}Literal error (catchable; following statement does not run). VFP9 rejects all four forms (retained COM evidence in the issue). Fail-first: 37 failures before, 0 after; valid-literal controls (doubled delimiters) pass both ways. The static-analysis/package source-validation acceptance criterion needs a comment/TEXT/continuation-aware lexer and is NOT done, so #6509 stays open with that scope noted.
